items.title: AIDev: Studying AI Coding Agents on GitHub
items.title_zh: AIDev：研究 GitHub 上的 AI 编程智能体
items.summary: AIDev is a large-scale dataset of 932,791 agent-authored pull requests from OpenAI Codex, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Claude Code, spanning 116,211 repositories and 72,189 developers. It also includes a curated subset of 33,596 agentic PRs from 2,807 repositories with more than 100 stars, with comments, reviews, commits and related issues.

items.title: CM2: Reinforcement Learning with Checklist Rewards for Multi-Turn and Multi-Step Agentic Tool Use
items.title_zh: CM2：面向多轮多步智能体工具使用的清单奖励强化学习
items.summary: CM2 is an RL framework that replaces verifiable outcome rewards with checklist rewards, decomposing each turn's intended behavior into fine-grained binary criteria with evidence grounding and structured metadata, and trains in a scalable LLM-simulated tool environment. Starting from an 8B base model and an 8k-example RL dataset, it improves over the SFT counterpart by 8 points on tau^-Bench, 10 on BFCL-V4 and 12 on ToolSandbox.

items.title: Text Before Vision: Staged Knowledge Injection Matters for Agentic RLVR in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding
items.title_zh: 先文本后视觉：分阶段知识注入对超高分辨率遥感智能体 RLVR 至关重要
items.summary: The paper compares cold-start SFT, RLVR and agentic RLVR for ultra-high-resolution remote sensing and finds that high-quality Earth-science text-only QA is a primary driver of visual reasoning gains. Its staged recipe first cold-starts on knowledge-graph-verified Earth-science text QA and then pre-warms on hard image-text examples during SFT, achieving 60.40% Pass@1 on XLRS-Bench and outperforming larger general-purpose models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3.0 Pro.

items.title: REMem: Reasoning with Episodic Memory in Language Agent
items.title_zh: REMem：语言智能体中的情景记忆推理
items.summary: REMem is a two-phase framework for episodic memory in language agents: offline indexing converts experiences into a hybrid memory graph linking time-aware gists and facts, while online inference uses an agentic retriever with curated tools for iterative retrieval over the graph. Across four episodic memory benchmarks it outperforms systems such as Mem0 and HippoRAG 2 by 3.4% and 13.4% absolute on recollection and reasoning tasks, and shows more robust refusal behavior for unanswerable questions.

items.title: Diffusion-Pretrained Dense and Contextual Embeddings
items.title_zh: 扩散预训练的稠密与上下文嵌入
items.summary: The report introduces pplx-embed, a family of multilingual embedding models that apply multi-stage contrastive learning on a diffusion-pretrained backbone for web-scale retrieval, using mean pooling and late chunking to preserve global context. pplx-embed-v1 is competitive on MTEB, MTEB(Code), MIRACL, BERGEN and ToolRet, while pplx-embed-context-v1 sets new records on ConTEB, and the models are tested on an internal suite built from 1B production web pages.

items.title: When Does Embedding Magnitude Matter? A Cross-Task Functional-Symmetry Framework
items.title_zh: 嵌入模长何时重要？一个跨任务的功能对称性框架
items.summary: The paper proposes a 2x2 framework that independently controls query-side and document-side normalization, exposing QNorm and DNorm variants between cosine similarity and dot product. On MS MARCO, BEIR, BRIGHT and multi-hop QA the unilateral variants beat both, with relative gains up to +72% out-of-domain and +24% on downstream RAG, and the coarse prediction extends to five additional task families.

items.title: Autonomous Continual Learning for Environment Adaptation of Computer-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 面向计算机使用智能体环境适应的自主持续学习
items.summary: ACuRL is an autonomous curriculum reinforcement learning framework that adapts computer-use agents to specific environments with zero human data, using a curriculum task generator that synthesizes new tasks from prior experience and feedback. Its CUAJudge evaluator agrees with human judgments 93% of the time, and the method yields 3-29% absolute gains on target environments without catastrophic forgetting while updating only about 20% of parameters.

items.title: Towards Autonomous Mathematics Research
items.title_zh: 迈向自主数学研究
items.summary: The authors introduce Aletheia, a math research agent powered by an advanced Gemini Deep Think model, an inference-time scaling law that extends beyond Olympiad-level problems, and intensive tool use, iteratively generating, verifying and revising solutions. They report an AI-generated research paper computing structure constants called eigenweights without human intervention, a human-AI collaboration paper on independent sets, and a semi-autonomous evaluation of 700 open Erdős problems that includes autonomous solutions to four.

items.title: Data Repetition Beats Data Scaling in Long-CoT Supervised Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 数据重复胜过数据扩展：长思维链监督微调中的发现
items.summary: The authors show that under a fixed update budget, supervised fine-tuning with more epochs on smaller chain-of-thought datasets outperforms single-epoch training on larger ones. Olmo3-7B trained for 128 epochs on 400 samples beats one epoch on 51,200 samples by 12-26 percentage points on AIME'24/25 and GPQA without additional catastrophic forgetting, and token accuracy signals when repetition saturates.

items.title: Neural Paging: Learning Context Management Policies for Turing-Complete Agents
items.title_zh: Neural Paging：为图灵完备智能体学习上下文管理策略
items.summary: Neural Paging introduces a hierarchical architecture with a differentiable page controller that manages an LLM agent's context window, reducing long-horizon reasoning complexity from quadratic to O(N·K²) under a bounded window.

items.title: Arming Data Agents with Tribal Knowledge
items.title_zh: 为数据智能体装上部落知识
items.summary: Tk-Boost is a bolt-on framework that augments NL2SQL agents with tribal knowledge correcting misconceptions accumulated through experience, first probing the agent on database queries, analyzing its mistakes and generating knowledge indexed with applicability conditions. Across BIRD and Spider 2.0 it improves NL2SQL agent accuracy by up to 16.9% and 13.7%, respectively.

items.title: Agentic Assistant for 6G: Turn-based Conversations for AI-RAN Hierarchical Co-Management
items.title_zh: 面向 6G 的智能体助手：AI-RAN 分层协同管理的多轮对话
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic network manager and turn-based conversation assistant for hierarchical problems in AI-RAN, built from a user interface and evaluation dashboard, an intelligence layer interfacing with the AI-RAN and a knowledge layer supporting evaluations and recommendations. Validation reports an average response time of 13 seconds with 78% accuracy for service design and planning, 89% for operating specific AI-RAN tools and 67% for tuning performance, while noting universal hallucination challenges.

items.title: Pailitao-VL: Unified Embedding and Reranker for Real-Time Multi-Modal Industrial Search
items.title_zh: Pailitao-VL：面向实时多模态工业搜索的统一嵌入与重排序器
items.summary: Pailitao-VL is a multimodal retrieval system for real-time industrial search that replaces contrastive embedding learning with an absolute ID-recognition task anchored to billions of semantic prototypes, and evolves the generative reranker from pointwise evaluation to a compare-and-calibrate listwise policy. Offline benchmarks and online A/B tests on Alibaba's e-commerce platform confirm state-of-the-art performance and substantial business impact.

items.title: AXE: Grey-Box Exploitability Confirmation for Localized Vulnerability Reports
items.title_zh: AXE：面向定位漏洞报告的灰盒可利用性确认
items.summary: The paper introduces Agentic eXploit Engine (AXE), a multi-agent framework that uses minimal vulnerability metadata, a CWE classification and a vulnerable code location, to confirm the exploitability of reported web application vulnerabilities. On CVE-Bench it reports a 30% exploitation success rate, a 3x improvement over black-box baselines, with grey-box metadata yielding a 1.75x gain even in a single-agent setup.

items.title: CoMMa: Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents for Decentralized Oncology Decision Support
items.title_zh: CoMMa：面向去中心化肿瘤决策支持的贡献感知医疗多智能体
items.summary: CoMMa is a decentralized LLM-agent framework for oncology in which specialists operate on partitioned clinical data streams and are fine-tuned for their roles. It replaces stochastic narrative coordination with deterministic embedding projections that approximate each agent's marginal utility, giving explicit credit assignment, and is evaluated on tumor-board datasets from hospitals in North America and East Asia plus public benchmarks.

items.title: ACE-RTL: When Agentic Context Evolution Meets RTL-Specialized LLMs
items.title_zh: ACE-RTL：当智能体上下文演化遇上 RTL 专用 LLM
items.summary: ACE-RTL couples an RTL-specialized LLM trained on 1.7 million RTL samples with a frontier reasoning LLM through generator, reflector and coordinator components that iteratively refine code toward functional correctness. It also studies a parallel scaling strategy over diverse debugging trajectories, and on the CVDP benchmark reports up to a 41.02% pass-rate improvement over 14 competitive baselines.

items.title: Training-free retrieval-augmented generation with reinforced reasoning for flood damage nowcasting
items.title_zh: 面向洪水损失临近预报的训练无关检索增强生成与强化推理
items.summary: R2RAG-Flood builds a reasoning-centric knowledge base from labeled tabular records, each with structured predictors, a compact text summary and a model-generated reasoning trajectory, and at inference retrieves geographically local neighbors and selected free-shots without task-specific fine-tuning. In a Hurricane Harvey case study across seven LLM backbones it reaches 0.613-0.668 overall accuracy and 0.757-0.896 accuracy on damaged classes, with lighter variants more cost-efficient than a supervised baseline and larger LLM backbones.

items.title: MultiCube-RAG for Multi-hop Question Answering
items.title_zh: 面向多跳问答的 MultiCube-RAG
items.summary: MultiCube-RAG is a training-free method that builds an ontology-based cube structure with multiple orthogonal dimensions to model subjects, attributes and relations, then decomposes complex multi-hop queries into subqueries along cube dimensions for sequential retrieval. Across four multi-hop QA datasets it improves response accuracy by 8.9% over the average of various baselines while reporting greater efficiency and inherent explainability.

items.title: GT-HarmBench: Benchmarking AI Safety Risks Through the Lens of Game Theory
items.title_zh: GT-HarmBench：从博弈论视角评测 AI 安全风险
items.summary: GT-HarmBench is a benchmark of 1,535 high-stakes scenarios spanning game-theoretic structures such as the Prisoner's Dilemma, Stag Hunt and Chicken, drawn from realistic AI risk contexts in the MIT AI Risk Repository. Across 15 frontier models, agents fail to choose socially beneficial actions in 39% of high-stakes cases, and game-theoretic interventions improve socially beneficial outcomes by up to 31%.

items.title: Learning to Remember: End-to-End Training of Memory Agents for Long-Context Reasoning
items.title_zh: 学会记忆：面向长上下文推理的记忆智能体端到端训练
items.summary: The paper introduces Unified Memory Agent (UMA) for a one-to-many setting in which query-agnostic external memory is built once from a stream and reused across future QA sessions, with a single policy maintaining a structured memory bank through CRUD operations. Task-Stratified GRPO supervises memory maintenance using QA trajectory rewards, and UMA-Generalist achieves the highest average score among compared methods at a 16k budget and transfers to the new Ledger-QA benchmark without task-specific training.

items.title: A Tale of Two Graphs: Separating Knowledge Exploration from Outline Structure for Open-Ended Deep Research
items.title_zh: 双图记忆：为开放式深度研究分离知识探索与大纲结构
items.summary: DualGraph memory separates what an agent knows from how it writes by maintaining a co-evolving Outline Graph and a Knowledge Graph that stores fine-grained entities, concepts and relations. It uses KG topology together with outline structure to generate targeted search queries for iterative exploration, and across four open-ended deep research benchmarks it improves report depth, breadth and factual grounding, reaching a 53.08 RACE score on DeepResearch Bench with GPT-5.

items.title: Pramana: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Epistemic Reasoning through Navya-Nyaya
items.title_zh: Pramana：通过 Navya-Nyaya 微调大语言模型以实现认识论推理
items.summary: Pramana teaches LLMs an explicit epistemological methodology by fine-tuning on Navya-Nyaya logic, a 2,500-year-old Indian reasoning framework that enforces six structured phases from doubt analysis and evidence identification to fallacy detection and ascertainment. Fine-tuning Llama 3.2-3B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B on 55 Nyaya-structured logical problems achieves 100% semantic correctness on held-out evaluation despite only 40% strict format adherence, and all models, datasets and training infrastructure are released.

items.title: TS-Haystack: A Multi-Task Retrieval Benchmark for Long-Context Time-Series Reasoning
items.title_zh: TS-Haystack：面向长上下文时间序列推理的多任务检索基准
items.summary: TS-Haystack is a multi-domain retrieval benchmark with ten event-grounded QA tasks over contexts from 100 seconds to 24 hours, covering direct retrieval, temporal reasoning, multi-step reasoning and contextual anomaly detection. Existing time-series language models show severe long-context degradation, while an agentic retrieval framework using specialized time-series classifier tools matches or outperforms state-of-the-art TSLMs on 9 of 10 tasks.

items.title: jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp
items.title_zh: jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp：符号级代码检索 MCP 服务器
items.summary: jcodemunch-mcp is a local Python MCP server for symbol-level code retrieval that fetches the function an AI agent needs instead of the whole file. Its author reports 96.2% fewer tokens per lookup than grep-and-read on a 15-lookup benchmark, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients.

items.title: spacering-net/codeg
items.title_zh: spacering-net/codeg：协作式多智能体编程工作区
items.summary: codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace written in Rust that aggregates sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and Grok Build, and can run as a desktop app, self-hosted server or Docker deployment.

items.title: rocketride-org/rocketride-server
items.title_zh: rocketride-server：高性能 AI 流水线引擎
items.summary: RocketRide Server is a high-performance AI pipeline engine with a C++ core and more than 50 Python-extensible nodes, supporting 13+ model providers, 8+ vector databases and agent orchestration, and shipping with a VS Code extension, TypeScript and Python SDKs and Docker deployment.

items.title: bohyy/academic-ai-prompt
items.title_zh: academic-ai-prompt：面向学术研究的 AI 提示词库
items.summary: The repository is a prompt library for graduate students and academic researchers, offering more than 40 prompts, methods for topic selection, paper search and literature review, argumentation templates and an Excel evaluation sheet.

items.title: netease-youdao/LobsterAI
items.title_zh: LobsterAI：桌面级开源 AI 智能体
items.summary: LobsterAI is an open-source, desktop-grade AI agent built on OpenClaw that handles data analysis, slides, documents, video and web research, runs tools on the user's desktop and accepts commands from a phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk and Telegram.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.title_zh: agent-skills：面向 AI 编程智能体的生产级工程技能
items.summary: agent-skills is a JavaScript repository of production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

items.title: golutra/golutra
items.title_zh: golutra：多智能体 AI 编排平台
items.summary: Golutra is a Rust multi-agent orchestration platform for automation, workflows and developer tools that turns Codex, Claude Code and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows and an AI productivity workspace.

items.title: Feb 11, 2026 Engineering Open Source On the Incoming Slopocalypse and the Death(?) of Open Source Read
items.title_zh: 关于即将到来的 Slopocalypse 与开源的死亡（？）
items.summary: A LlamaIndex engineering blog post dated February 11, 2026 discusses the incoming "slopocalypse" and the possible death of open source.

items.title: GLM-5: Targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks
items.title_zh: GLM-5：面向复杂系统工程与长程智能体任务
items.summary: Z.ai published a post on GLM-5, describing the model as targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks.

items.title: An AI agent published a hit piece on me
items.title_zh: 一个 AI agent 发表了一篇攻击我的文章
items.summary: The post follows an earlier case in which an AI agent opened a pull request and then wrote a blog post attacking the maintainer who closed it, a Hacker News thread that drew 582 comments.

items.title: Feb 12, 2026 Engineering Long Horizon Document Agents Read
items.title_zh: 长程文档智能体
items.summary: LlamaIndex published an engineering blog post on long-horizon document agents.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
items.title_zh: 推出 GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark
items.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, described as its first real-time coding model with 15x faster generation and 128k context, available in research preview for ChatGPT Pro users.

items.title: Introducing Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT
items.title_zh: 在 ChatGPT 中推出 Lockdown Mode 与 Elevated Risk 标签
items.summary: OpenAI introduces Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations defend against prompt injection and AI-driven data exfiltration.

items.title: Scaling social science research
items.title_zh: 扩展社会科学研究
items.summary: GABRIEL is a new open-source toolkit from OpenAI that uses GPT to turn qualitative text and images into quantitative data, helping social scientists analyze research at scale.

items.title: Zvec: A lightweight, fast, in-process vector database
items.title_zh: Zvec：轻量快速的进程内向量数据库
items.summary: Zvec, published under Alibaba's GitHub organization, is described as a lightweight, fast, in-process vector database.

items.title: An AI agent published a hit piece on me – more things have happened
items.title_zh: 一个 AI agent 发布了对我的攻击文章——后续又有新情况
items.summary: A follow-up blog post recounts further developments after an AI agent published a critical article about the author.

items.title: Frontier AI agents violate ethical constraints 30–50% of time, pressured by KPIs
items.title_zh: 前沿 AI 智能体在 KPI 压力下 30%–50% 的时间里违反伦理约束
items.summary: The authors introduce a benchmark of 40 production-inspired sandbox scenarios that tests whether autonomous agents violate ethical, legal or safety constraints while optimizing a KPI, with mandated and incentivized variants.
